objects.description: [OSX/Shlayer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0402) has collected the IOPlatformUUID, session UID, and the OS version using the command sw_vers -productVersion.(Citation: Carbon Black Shlayer Feb 2019)(Citation: sentinelone shlayer to zshlayer)
